links.outcome: Discrimination and calibration of new emergency admission score versus previously deployed scores
links.effect: Improvements in discrimination and calibration over previous scores deployed in Scotland, with stability over a 3-year timeframe (no numbers in abstract)
links.quote: We demonstrate improvements in discrimination and calibration with respect to previous scores deployed in Scotland, as well as stability over a 3-year timeframe.

unlisted_practices: Quantifying the effect of individual input features on risk predictions
Analysing predictive performance by reason for admission
Guidance on safely updating risk models already deployed at population level

screen.reason: Evaluates performance, temporal stability, subgroup calibration/fairness, and safe updating considerations for SPARRAv4, an emergency admission risk prediction tool being prepared for nationwide deployment in Scotland.
